scope: Post-hoc reconstruction of existing histories only. No new training, changed observations, checkpoint selection or original pass criterion. Train crossings are diagnostic and never replace held-out crossings. This checks recorded histories and binds checkpoints by hash; it does not repeat the earlier checkpoint forward replay.
interpretation: A training/held-out gap shows that fitting the finite training set is insufficient. It does not by itself identify a causal architecture defect or prove that more regularization will help. These are adaptively reused synthetic tasks, not fresh transfer evidence.
